test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 29 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If Rs. 5,000 becomes Rs. 5,900 in one year, what will Rs. 8,000 become at the end of 5 years at the same rate of simple interest?
solution:
**Given:**

5000 becomes 5900 in one year

**Formula Used:**

Amount = Principal + Interest

Interest = (Ptimes Rtimes T)/(100)

**Calculation:**

According to the formula

Amount = Principal-Interest

Interest = Principal - Amount = 5900 - 5000 = Rs. 900

Interest = (Ptimes Rtimes T)/(100)

⇒ 900 = (5000times Rtimes 1)/(100)=50R

R = 18%

Interest earned on Rs. 8000 at 18% in 5 years will be

Interest = (Ptimes Rtimes T)/(100)=(8000times 18×5)/(100)=Rs. 7200

Amount = Principal + Interest = 8000 + 7200 = Rs. 15200

**Hence, The amount after 5 years at 18% on 8000 will be Rs. 15200.**
